substantiveWork.title: Tribal Education Department — mission, Language Department and Head Start program collection
substantiveWork.publisher: Kickapoo Traditional Tribe of Texas, Tribal Education Department
substantiveWork.annotation: The Tribe-linked departmental publication supplies a direct account of its language curriculum, learning materials, Head Start resources and family supports. The Language page dates its curriculum work to 2017 and describes classes and integration with other education programs; Head Start lists a Kickapoo immersion-language resource book and family-engagement resources. These are the department’s descriptions and aims, not independently evaluated participation, fluency or learning outcomes. The three selected public pages are one continuing collection, not three separate works.
substantiveWork.contentReviewScope: Read actual rendered public Home Page mission and program navigation, the complete Language Department body, and Head Start program/resources, curriculum platforms, family services, health/disability and food-service descriptions. The official kickapootexas.org homepage links directly to this Canva-hosted department site. Text was read in the normal browser because automated extraction returned no body. Personal staff/contact details, schedules, numerical health deadlines and promotional quality claims were not used in synthesis. No member-only material, classes, lesson books, student records or software were accessed; no photographs reproduced.
substantiveWork.accessNotes: Publicly readable in the browser without an account. Automated web extraction returned an empty body; this is not evidence of a reader paywall.
